recordStores.note: Auto-memory index and its per-topic files; the harness loads these into every session automatically, so a sub-agent spawned to re-check a claim stored here is not blind by default.

Global instructions file read at the start of every session. If the claim under review was ever asserted here, step 4 must quarantine the entry or run the blind check somewhere this file is not loaded.
Nightly cross-machine digest cache for project-x, consulted only when explicitly opened. Safe ground for a blind sub-agent as long as nothing points it there.

primarySources.note: Personal note vault. Dated entries written at the time of a decision or observation count as primary evidence; later notes that merely restate the claim are witnesses, not evidence.

Source repository for project-x. A claim about a file path, config value or function signature is verified against this repo's current working tree, not against a memory entry's cached description of it.
